def: to stun, i.e. stupefy (with sleep or death)
kjv: (be fast a-, be in a deep, cast into a dead, that) sleep(-er, -eth).

words.word: with me i was in a deep sleep
then was i in a deep sleep
unto him what meanest thou o sleeper

occurrences.text: Then Jael Heber’s wife took a nail of the tent, and took an hammer in her hand, and went softly unto him, and smote the nail into his temples, and fastened it into the ground: for he was fast asleep and weary. So he died.
He that gathereth in summer is a wise son: but he that sleepeth in harvest is a son that causeth shame.
Now as he was speaking with me, I was in a deep sleep on my face toward the ground: but he touched me, and set me upright.
words: with me I was in a deep sleep

occurrences.text: Yet heard I the voice of his words: and when I heard the voice of his words, then was I in a deep sleep on my face, and my face toward the ground.
words: then was I in a deep sleep

occurrences.text: So the shipmaster came to him, and said unto him, What meanest thou, O sleeper? arise, call upon thy God, if so be that God will think upon us, that we perish not.
words: unto him What meanest thou O sleeper
